personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center where metrics dominate, utilizing stark data visualization and ember accents to deliver instant operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Dense and tactical. Use dividers and tonal separation instead of large padding and shadows. Ensure tight grouping for metrics and stats.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with tight borders for sticky headers or bottom tabs to maintain the tactical, operational feel.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. Clarity and instantaneous readability beat aesthetic softness in a cybersecurity command center.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure gateway with biometric and hardware key options.
screens.layout: Minimalist form. Centered branding. Large primary CTA for Single Sign-On / Biometrics, secondary for Email. No unnecessary decoration.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Live threat tracking and system status at a glance.

states.loading: Skeleton of metrics updating in real-time.

screens.layout: Use the 'dark abstract geometric' texture as a 30% opacity header background. Top section: High-level AI-generated status sentence ('3 active threats mitigated in last hour'). Followed by edge-to-edge stacked modules for real-time risk gauges and recent alerts. Use dense, tabular layouts.

screens.name: Devices
screens.purpose: Zero-trust access management with individual trust scores.
screens.layout: List view. Each row shows device name, connection status, MFA icon, and a prominent trust score metric (condensed font). Use sticky filters (e.g., 'Compromised', 'Trusted', 'Pending') at the top.

screens.name: AI_Assistant
screens.purpose: Conversational interface to analyze threats and recommend fixes.
screens.layout: Chat interface. AI messages feature a subtle 'binary code lines' background texture at 10% opacity. Responses include actionable, inline components (e.g., a 'Block IP' button directly in the chat).

screens.name: Audit
screens.purpose: Comprehensive security score and detailed compliance reporting.
screens.layout: Hero image ('server room') with heavy gradient-to-dark scrim. Giant security score at the top (using Rajdhani display font). Below: segmented controls for 'Network', 'Endpoints', 'Data'. Bar charts and risk indicators.

ai_assistant_bg.alt: Green binary code lines creating a digital matrix effect

audit_report_hero.alt: A rack of electronic equipment in a dark server room

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the '7 Dark-First Utility DARK' layout principles: use sharp borders (sm: 2, md: 4 radius max), stacked modules, and exposed system states. Absolutely no soft shadows or glassmorphism.
The primary brand color is Rust/Ember (#EA580C) to emphasize alertness and tracking. Only use success/green (#10B981) for resolved or safe states.
Rely heavily on typography for visual hierarchy. Use Rajdhani for all large metrics, scores, IPs, and section headers. Use DM Sans for readable body content and chat logs.
Ensure the sticky header and bottom tabs use a solid surfaceSecondary (#18181B) rather than a blur effect.
For the AI Assistant screen, apply the `ai_assistant_bg` image as a subtle background for the AI's chat bubbles, keeping opacity extremely low (e.g., 5-10%) so text remains fully legible.

For the Dashboard, place an AI-generated contextual summary (e.g., 'System stable, 2 minor threats blocked') at the very top before the user gets to the raw charts, per modern tactical design research.
All images used as backgrounds MUST include the top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast.
